title: 02 · Command palette (Margin)
strengths: Sits in a real page: the palette floats over a manuscript with chapter title, word count and 'Saved', so it reads as a tool and not a floating card
Restraint: paper, ink, 1 px rules, two faces (IBM Plex Sans, Newsreader), no hue; matches are weight 600 plus a hairline underline, exactly the house rule
Believable content: 'in The Salt Road ×' scope chip, group counts, 'Salt Road / Ch. 3' paths, an empty state that offers '⌘N starts a draft named "qzxv"', and keycaps for every key the footer names
slop_signals: Row metadata abbreviations 'edited 2 d' and '2,140 w' are truncated in a way no shipped product uses (real rows say '2d ago' or '2,140 words')
The scattered fuzzy-match underlines in 'Sh ore leave: rev erse outline' make four rows look noisy at once; real palettes bold the run and skip the underline
fixes: Write metadata as '2 days ago' and '2,140 words' (or '2d' / '2.1k words'), right-aligned in the quiet grey
Keep the weight highlight and drop the hairline underline under matched letters; or underline only when the match is a single run

references.what: Grouped results with breadcrumb paths ('Personal > Feedback Categorizer') and an 'Open ↵' hint on the selected row; the same anatomy, same quietness
Group labels, a description line under each row, ESC in the input and 'Select / Open' keycaps in the footer
Long result list with one-line previews and footer key hints; the hover state is barely a tint
A category filter inside the search field like our scope chip, plus a preview pane for the selected result

owner.said: the one web component that is not ugly
